title: Make the Infinite Goal Chase refusable instead of narrated
problem: Both operating work packets recorded 'EXECUTABLE ASPIRATION REGISTRY DEFERRED' while aspiration state lived as prose inside a JSON field: an active_aspiration string, an active_gate string, a backcast string. Prose records intent and refuses nothing. With aspiration state unstructured, nothing prevented a simulation or a passing test suite from being narrated as aspiration progress, nothing forced a campaign to declare its success threshold before running, nothing stopped a second bottleneck metric from running beside the first, and a blocked aspiration could be dropped silently, discarding the finding about the world that produced the block.
founder_intent_refs: Master mandate section 33: the Infinite Goal Chase loop, and what infinite does not mean
Master mandate section 34: durable aspiration registry, thirteen statuses, never delete blocked aspirations silently
Master mandate section 35: Backcast GPS G/P/S, and the six questions every campaign must answer
Master mandate section 36: prefer bottlenecks that unlock many aspirations
Master mandate section 37: BUILD is one of seven dispositions; mission progress can exceed ownership value
Master mandate section 50: one dominant SBM per operating period
Master mandate section 80: reconciled real outcome outranks simulation; do not invert the hierarchy
Master mandate section 88 item 15: build Aspiration Registry plus Backcast GPS cards
baseline: Branch claude/daleobanks-complete-build-arqtg5 at cfaf629, stacked on PR #67 (0d996ca). 338 tests passing. Aspiration state present only as prose in governance/operating_work_packet.json under aspiration_campaign_state.

disadvantages: The one deliverable that costs no founder authority stays deferred indefinitely
Nothing structurally prevents simulation from being narrated as aspiration progress

advantages.amplified_value: The same dead route stops being rediscovered as though nobody had tried it; the block itself becomes reusable knowledge.

advantages.statement: Primitives rank by live aspirations unlocked, and BUILD is not the default.

pass_2.attack_summary: Attacked the strengthened design for bypass, for encoding a judgment as if it were physics, for becoming a second bureaucracy, and for the possibility that its own existence gets reported as aspiration movement.

new_weaknesses.statement: A caller with session access can construct AspirationGateEvent directly and add it, bypassing every service guard.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Recorded as an explicit residual risk rather than papered over. The guards bind the service path; the store has never enforced invariants for any record in this repository, so this is a known property of the persistence layer, not a new hole. verified_gates_cleared independently re-checks the evidence tier when counting, so a directly inserted weak-tier CLEARED still does not increment the metric.

new_weaknesses.statement: Cutting external evidence at authorized_pilot will refuse a genuinely strong working-prototype result.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Accepted deliberately and named in counterevidence. The bar is a single module constant with the founder's ordering transcribed beside it, so raising or lowering it is one reviewable edit.

new_weaknesses.statement: The registry and the work packet could both claim to own aspiration state.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: The work packet points at the registry rather than restating it; the registry adds no scheduler, no routes, and no second metric surface.

new_weaknesses.statement: Shipping the measuring instrument could be read as moving the measurement.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Nothing is seeded, the guardian's dissent is binding on reporting, and the commit and work packet both state that VERIFIED_ASPIRATION_GATES_CLEARED is 0 before and after.

new_weaknesses.statement: Aspirations can never be deleted, so a mistaken or duplicate entry is permanent.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Intended. SUPERSEDED and RETIRED exist for exactly that, and both carry a reason and an actor. Permanence of the record is cheaper than losing a finding.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: A visible constant is the honest way to hold a judgment; the alternative is the same judgment scattered across call sites.

pass_2.final_design: Five additive dataclasses (AspirationRecord, BackcastPath, SharedPrimitive, AspirationCampaign, AspirationGateEvent) and one service, services/aspiration_registry.py. Thirteen statuses exactly as specified. No delete method, asserted by test. Backcast requires G, P, and S, with the nearest stage becoming the current gate and revisions superseding rather than overwriting. Campaigns require all six predeclarations, must attack the current gate, cannot run on a terminal aspiration, and cannot coexist with a different live SBM. Gate clearance requires evidence at or above authorized_pilot plus at least one external reference; REROUTED, DEFERRED, and FALSIFIED accept any tier. Unknown tiers rank lowest. Primitives rank by live aspirations unlocked and default to UNDECIDED. Nothing seeded, no API routes, no scheduler.

residual_risks.risk: Direct store writes bypass every service guard.
residual_risks.mitigation: verified_gates_cleared re-checks the evidence tier at count time, so a bypassed weak CLEARED still does not increment the metric. Add an API-layer guard if routes are ever exposed.

residual_risks.risk: The authorized_pilot bar refuses a legitimate strong prototype.
residual_risks.mitigation: Single named constant with the founder's ordering transcribed beside it.
residual_risks.review_trigger: A refusal is judged wrong in practice.

residual_risks.risk: Building the instrument is mistaken for moving the metric.
residual_risks.mitigation: Nothing seeded; binding dissent recorded; metric reported as 0 before and after.
residual_risks.review_trigger: Any report describing this work as aspiration progress.

residual_risks.risk: No aspiration campaign can run at all until the founder supplies resource_ceiling and stop_condition.
residual_risks.mitigation: This is the intended behavior and it names the exact gap; it is a blocker on reality, not on the code.
residual_risks.review_trigger: The founder supplies the missing declarations.

dissent.handling: Binding on reporting, not on implementation. The registry ships; what it is allowed to be called does not include progress.

entries.position: This is the measuring instrument for aspiration progress and must never be counted as aspiration progress.
entries.rationale: VERIFIED_ASPIRATION_GATES_CLEARED is 0 before and after, and by the registry's own rule it cannot be moved from inside this repository.
entries.evidence_threshold: One AspirationGateEvent with outcome CLEARED at authorized_pilot or stronger, carrying an external evidence reference from a founder-declared surface.
entries.review_trigger: The founder declares surface, timezone, source packet, destination, resource ceiling, and stop condition.

entries.position: Refusing every campaign until six fields exist could read as the tool obstructing the work.
entries.rationale: The refusal names the missing fields, and those fields are founder decisions that must be made regardless, so the friction produces the input rather than replacing it.
entries.evidence_threshold: A pilot delayed by predeclaration rather than by a genuinely absent founder input.

authority_impact.notes: No capability, credential, connector, publishing path, spending path, or scheduler. The registry only records and refuses. It narrows what may be claimed and creates nothing that can act.

migration_plan: Five additive dataclasses in db/models.py, auto-registered by the existing durable object store, plus one new service module. No schema version change, no data migration, no seeded records, no API routes. Service layer only so the branch merges cleanly with the Phase 1 branch's app.py changes.

steps: No data migration is required because nothing was seeded and no existing record gained a field.
Re-run the suite; the expected post-revert state is 338 passing.

kill_criteria: The registry records a gate as cleared on evidence weaker than authorized_pilot.
A campaign runs without all six predeclarations.
Two bottleneck metrics run simultaneously without refusal.
A blocked aspiration disappears without a status history entry.
The registry becomes a second planning bureaucracy restating the work packet.
Its existence is reported as aspiration progress.
review_trigger: The founder supplies resource ceiling and stop condition for the first pilot, or any refusal is judged wrong in practice.
